flagged.evidence: The proof says, “Block maxima, merges, and loop overhead add at most O(n^2) operations since b≥1.” With b=1, there can be O(n^2) summary merges, each updating a length-v weighted-value vector at O(v) cost, so merges can require O(n^2 v) operations. The theorem's stated total bound still accommodates this cost, but this intermediate estimate is false.
